messages:
sara: Kickoff: We're scheduling a KMS rekey for vault-prod and partner namespaces next Tuesday. Need staggered windows and oncall handshake. Any blockers? cc @mike @alex @oncall

mike: what's the blast radius? which services use the old keys?

alex: quick list: auth-service, embeddings-worker, billing-cron. CI runners use KMS to unwrap deploy creds.

jamie: If we rotate, ensure CI has fallback wrapped keys pushed to artifact bucket first. otherwise deploys will fail. :grimacing: 

sara: plan: 3 windows: 02:00-03:00 UTC (staging), 04:00-05:00 (tier1 prod), 06:00-07:00 (tier2 prod). We'll rotate KMS key metadata then rewrap Vault transit keys. Oncall to monitor.

oncall: I can be live for tier1. Which metric alerts?

alex: watch vault:auth:deny spikes, vault:transit:errors, deploy-fail rate. IFTTT: PagerDuty if deploy failures >5 in 10m.

mike: propose pre-rotation smoke: rewrap test-service and run `vault kv get secret/test || true` in staging CI job. snippet:

```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=redwood-main --location=global ...
gsutil cp gs://redwood-kms-prewrap/test-service-wrap.json /tmp/
vault write transit/keys/test-service -<<EOF
...
EOF
```

jamie: I'll push prewrapped blobs to gs://redwood-kms-prewrap and set lifecycle TTL 48h.

sara: ownership: @alex owns rewrap script, @mike owns CI changes, @jamie owns prewrap artifacts, @oncall will run rollback if issues. security-team to approve read/write IAM changes.

sec-bot: POLICY ALERT: IAM change proposed requires org-admin approval. File created: https://gcsa/req/PR-992

mike: ack, I'll request approval. timeline: open PR today, get approval by EOD Fri.

oncall: If rollout fails, rollback steps? need runbook quick:

alex: short runbook:
1) abort rewrap
2) restore previous KMS key alias
3) re-deploy old wrapped blobs from gs://redwood-kms-backups
4) restart services

sara: OK. final: I'll create the scheduled rotation ticket and ping security for IAM. @deploy-bot will post deploy windows.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: KMS rekey windows created in calendar -> https://calendar/evt/12345

jamie: 👍 I'll be around for tier2 window as well. :thumbsup:

oncall: I'll be available for tier1 and monitor dashboards. If alerts, I'll escalate to sec oncall.

sara: thanks all. dropping checklist in the ticket and will follow up with PR links in #eng-sre.
